svg.title: An app calling a large language model through the Dapr conversation API
svg.desc: On the left, a green hexagon named App. An arrow runs from it to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, named Dapr sidecar, and the arrow is labelled POST over the path /v1.0-alpha2/conversation/<llm-name>/converse. A second arrow runs from the sidecar into a dashed area captioned LLMs, which holds the marks and names of the nine supported providers in two columns: Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, DeepSeek, GoogleAI, Huggingface, Mistral, Ollama, OpenAI and OpenRouter.
